title: Insight: The "Second Half" of New Energy Power Battery Assembly Technology
contentHtml:
With the explosive growth of the new energy vehicle market, power battery assembly technology is facing new development opportunities. This article explores the trends in the "second half" of new energy power battery assembly technology.

Automation Becomes a Necessity

Under the "dual carbon" goals, the new energy industry is thriving, with surging demand for power batteries. Traditional manual assembly methods can no longer meet the needs for large-scale, high-efficiency, and high-quality production, making automated assembly technology an industry necessity.

Deep Software-Hardware Integration

The core of a unmanned factory lies not in hardware stacking, but in data flow integration. The efficient integration of WCS (Warehouse Control System) with automated robotic arms is key to achieving smart production. Through TCP/IP communication protocols, real-time interconnection of equipment status and digital transparent management of production data are realized.

Leveraging 19 years of deep expertise in automation, TXAM has successfully developed a series of equipment for new energy battery module PACK production lines, which have been deployed at multiple leading enterprises.
